nameEn: Manufacture of paints, varnishes and similar coatings, printing ink and mastics
description: This class includes the manufacture of paints, varnishes and similar coatings, printing ink and mastics.
includes: manufacture of paints and varnishes, enamels or lacquers
manufacture of putties, paint fillers and other non-refractory surfacing preparations
manufacture of encaustic and similar preparations
excludes: manufacture of dyestuffs and pigments, see 2012
manufacture of inks for writing, drawing and other purposes, see 2029
